title: Miaoxin and the Characteristic of Confidence
speaker: IkuShun Desiree Webster
summary: IkuShun Desiree Webster emphasizes the importance of trusting our innate wisdom and experience, rather than relying on intellectual thinking. This trust allows us to break free from conceptual patterns and tap into a deeper sense of confidence and awareness, which can help us overcome fear and live more authentically. By cultivating this trust, we can deepen our connection to the present moment and keep ancient teachings relevant in our daily lives.
